findings.description: The check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so plain `str` filenames are no longer wrapped in a tuple.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `click.edit(filename="file.txt")`. A `str` is not an `os.PathLike`, so it is passed unwrapped to `edit_files`, which iterates it and treats each character as a separate filename. The editor is then opened on files named "f", "i", "l" and so on. This breaks the most common usage.
